introduction: Find the missing key, plan your way into the hero’s cell, and follow the steak exchange to its tragic ending. Returning the key and feeding the hero are separate recorded exchanges; other prisoners’ stories have no implemented rescue outcome.
orientation: Enter from Split Shield’s Eastern Gate (10327) and head EAST through the muddy approach to the main square (53202). From the square, NORTH reaches the guard and elven barracks, SOUTH the barbarian and dwarven barracks, and EAST the human and gnomish barracks. Doors, darkness and hostile inhabitants can affect your route.

Ask the master slaves, camp or encampement. Ask the hero food, hi, hello, howdy, greetings, help, quest, camp, orc or encampenet. These spellings match his existing topics. Several keywords lead to the same response; asking each one does not earn a separate achievement.

The slave guard in the northern barracks carries the small metallic key. The mud on the approach mentions something shiny, but there is no matching key on the ground. A key received from another player still fits the exchange; carrying it does not show how you obtained it.

The same key opens the hidden trapdoor between the main square and the hero’s cell (53212). Find the door before trying to unlock it, then OPEN it before going DOWN. Lockpicking remains another option if your skills and tools allow it. Each successful use of the key has a 20 percent chance to break it.

Plan access to the cell before giving the key to the master. He takes it in exchange for the large steak and a configured reward of 1,500 coins. Returning the key does not open the trapdoor or restore your key. An already opened door may let you enter without carrying one.

The master also carries a copy of the steak. A matching steak obtained from another source can be offered to the hero without your own key-return record. Having a steak does not prove you completed the master’s exchange, and the available supply is limited.

The hero accepts the exact large steak for a lightweight spiked mace and a configured reward of 15,000 experience, subject to the game’s reward rules. The scene ends with poisoning and his death. The journal records that tragic exchange; it does not describe a successful rescue or count it as a combat kill.

Although named as food, this particular steak cannot normally be eaten by a player. It is the specific item for the hero’s final exchange. Ordinary food, including the half-eaten iron ration carried by the enslaved human in cell 53210, does not substitute for it.

The hero also has an ordinary-food request that would leave him asking for more, with no reward. That request is currently unavailable with active accounting and is excluded from achievements and dailies. Use the exact steak exchange described above for the supported story.

The well in the square supplies water. The gnomish man in cell 53211 wears a bag associated with white and black scrolls. Water, scrolls and the other prisoners’ backstories have no additional local quest outcome, teaching objective or liberation objective.

The southern barracks description points toward gnomes, but the cell directly EAST of it (53206) holds dwarves. The gnomes are off the eastern barracks instead. Descriptions of mines, escape and family hardship do not add travel or rescue steps to these two exchanges.

contacts.name: an incapacitated barbarian hero

stories.title: Slave master: return the missing key
stories.summary: Return the small metallic key for the large steak and a coin reward. The same key opens the hero’s trapdoor, and this exchange consumes it. Plan access before handing it over; returning it does not unlock the cell.

steps.hint: The slave guard in the northern barracks carries this hidden key. The shiny-mud description on the approach has no matching key on the ground. Each successful keyed unlock has a 20 percent break chance, so a used key may not survive for hand-in. Carry the item loose for this inventory check; held or nested copies do not count here. This check shows current possession, not whether you recovered the item yourself or received it from another player.

stories.title: Barbarian hero: the final steak
stories.summary: Offer the exact large steak for the lightweight spiked mace and an experience reward. The scene ends with the hero being poisoned and dying. Recording this exchange does not record a successful rescue, a combat kill or the freeing of other prisoners.

steps.text: Optional access tool: carry the trapdoor key
steps.hint: Find the hidden trapdoor beneath the main square, unlock or pick it as your skills allow, then OPEN it before entering the hero’s cell. A key held in your hand can unlock the door even though this loose-inventory check does not count it. An already opened door can make the key unnecessary.
